title: Pretzel with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pretzel body: golden-brown twisted loop -->
  <g fill='none' stroke='#D4941E' stroke-width='12' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'>
    <!-- bottom U shape -->
    <path d='M28 70 Q20 85 35 85 Q50 85 50 72' />
    <path d='M72 70 Q80 85 65 85 Q50 85 50 72' />
    <!-- top loops crossing -->
    <path d='M28 70 Q20 45 35 38 Q48 30 50 48' />
    <path d='M72 70 Q80 45 65 38 Q52 30 50 48' />
    <!-- inner crossing lines -->
    <path d='M50 48 Q58 58 50 68' stroke='#E8B54A' stroke-width='10' />
  </g>

  <!-- lighter highlight on top of pretzel -->
  <g fill='none' stroke='#F2CB6E' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M33 42 Q40 35 47 41' />
    <path d='M67 42 Q60 35 53 41' />
    <path d='M30 66 Q25 74 34 78' />
    <path d='M70 66 Q75 74 66 78' />
  </g>

  <!-- salt crystals -->
  <g fill='#FFF6D6'>
    <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='2' />
    <circle cx='66' cy='52' r='2' />
    <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='1.8' />
    <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='1.8' />
    <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='2' />
    <circle cx='62' cy='76' r='2' />
    <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='1.6' />
    <circle cx='26' cy='62' r='1.5' />
    <circle cx='74' cy='62' r='1.5' />
  </g>

  <!-- smiling face on center -->
  <!-- eyes: bright cyan glowing dots -->
  <g fill='#5FF2E8'>
    <circle cx='42' cy='57' r='3.5' />
    <circle cx='58' cy='57' r='3.5' />
  </g>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <circle cx='41' cy='56' r='1.2' />
    <circle cx='57' cy='56' r='1.2' />
  </g>

  <!-- smile: bright pink curve -->
  <path d='M40 65 Q50 75 60 65' fill='none' stroke='#FF6FBF' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' />

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <g fill='#FF9AD5' opacity='0.7'>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='63' rx='4' ry='2.5' />
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='63' rx='4' ry='2.5' />
  </g>
</svg>
